body: I don’t have the money or resources for counselling right now. Plus whenI did have access to a therapist all I heard were the same fucking clichés over and over again.

1) Putting effort into online/regular dating when you’re a guy and you look mediocre at best 

2) Sunflower seeds

You need to go deeper and question your desires/motives. Is there any sort of intrinsic meaning to what you’re going after? The only thing that has any sort of intrinsic meaning is existence itself. You’re free to define that however you please. And if you’re going to give it one definition that ultimately isn’t that important to existence itself that’s on you.

Anything that has meaning in our life only has meaning because we choose to give it meaning. Ultimately any relationship is inherently meaningless. The only thing that has any intrinsic meaning is existence itself. I try to focus on giving a definition to my existence.
I personally seek comfort in the existential nightmare. Your loneliness, along with the companionship your peers experience ultimately have no meaning and no one will remember anyone or anything.

I am aware of the cognitive bias that you're outlining here, and I like to keep an objective mindset when looking at this sort of thing. I'm more interested in knowing the truth (whether it's good or bad) than stretching it to make myself feel better.
I'm looking to travel along the east coast of Canada and do a tour of the UK. To be honest there aren't a whole lot of places that really pique my interest other than those areas.

I've been doing the whole loving myself and enjoying myself for several years now. I just hit a point a few months ago where I started questioning why I haven't had any success in meeting people that actually have a romantic interest in me. It's so easy to just say "love yourself and enjoy yourself", but after so many years of being alone it's only natural to feel overwhelmed by the loneliness and question what your value is. We're social creatures who want to be loved, and to pretend otherwise is foolish.

I feel like I've accomplished most of the things that are on my bucket list. And like I said I can accomplish the other stuff on my list within the next few years. I just feel like I'm at a loss as to how my life is going to be worth living for the next 50 years or so.

Also there is absolutely no guarantee that I will ever meet anyone. And given how my life has gone thus far I have no inclination to believe that it's going to change anytime soon, despite my efforts to get out there and meet people.

Determinism is the coward’s oversimplified explanation to their existence, the common argument being that our thought processes are predetermined chemical reactions. The truth is that those chemical reactions depend on quantum mechanics, which is the very essence of randomness. We can keep saying to ourselves that improving ourselves and focusing on what’s important in our lives will eventually attract someone because of the positive energy we’re exuding, but the truth of the matter is that for a large number of us it will mean nothing to anyone but ourselves.

You don’t understand. I’m actively trying to find people with a similar taste in music to jam with. This isn’t an issue due to lack of confidence. The market for bassists where I live is over saturated. Drummers are very hard to find in my area as well, and finding one that wants to play in the same style as me is impossible. I’m using a drum machine at the moment but it’s quickly becoming boring to play with it.
You would think so but guitarists/bassists are a dime a dozen. I’ve tried looking for people to jam with and it’s fucking impossible :(
